title: Placement & tech Intern
description:
**Job Description**

**About Newton School of Technology**

Newton School of Technology (NST) is a new-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a 4-year B.Tech in Computer Science and AI, focused on hands-on learning and deep industry integration. Within two years, over 93% of students have secured paid internships with companies like Razorpay, SarvamAI, and DRDO, along with global exposure through tech treks to Singapore and Silicon Valley.

**Role**

We are looking for a Placement & Tech Intern to support B.Tech CSE students with their technical and placement readiness. You will work on DSA, AI, student engagement, placement operations, and data tracking to help students prepare for successful tech placements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Student Readiness & Tech Support**

* Support students with DSA and AI-focused preparation.
* Track student progress and identify students needing support.
* Help students prepare for technical assessments and interviews.
* Conduct readiness checks and follow up on preparation activities.

**Placement Operations & Coordination**

* Coordinate placement drives, interviews, schedules, and student applications.
* Maintain placement trackers, dashboards, and student records.
* Coordinate with students, academic teams, and recruiters.

**Student Engagement & Communication**

* Communicate placement updates, opportunities, eligibility, and deadlines.
* Address student queries and coordinate resolutions.
* Conduct student briefings and follow-ups.

**Data & Reporting**

* Track applications, interview stages, offers, and student drop-offs.
* Analyze placement data and identify key trends.
* Maintain reports using Excel and Google Sheets.

**Key Requirements**

* Pursuing/recent B.Tech/B.E in CSE, IT, or related fields.
* Strong programming fundamentals and DSA.
* Good coding and problem-solving skills.
* Interest in AI and technology.
* Good communication and student-handling skills.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets.
* LeetCode/CodeChef/HackerRank experience encouraged.
* Strong ownership, organization, and attention to detail.

**Good to Have**

Power BI/Tableau

GitHub/coding projects

AI/ML exposure

DSA mentoring/technical community experience

**Why Join us**

Work on DSA, AI & technical readiness with CSE & AI students.

Opportunity for full-time conversion after the internship.

Competitive full-time compensation, above market standards.

**Open Positions**

2

**Mandatory Skills**

DSA, Programming, Student Coordination, Placement Operations, Excel, Communication, High Ownership
